title: Active-version rebuild, explicit pin and terminal refusal
prerequisites: QA-owned template only. Publish two compatible and recorded versions A/B with UUIDs, identical except safe nonsecret marker; confirm active-version/require_active_version controls and service account privileges.
Never promote production template. Stop/rebuild only disposable QA workspaces; sequentially change overlay and restart dedicated QA relay, recording config hash.
Provider supports redelivery of same session. If not, record blocked instead of using new-session creation as evidence of rebuild.

Q04-d.fixture: Scoped QA rebuild HTTP 400/403 and separately transient failure

variants.title: Unpinned rebuild adopts active version

steps.action: Set QA active version A, leave pool template_version absent, start a disposable session on each provider; record session and workspace IDs and successful build version A.
steps.evidence: Version UUID A and build/session/workspace IDs.

steps.action: Promote only QA version B; stop both recorded workspaces; redeliver the SAME provider sessions, then poll every 15s.
steps.expected: Dispatcher rebuilds each existing workspace against active version B, not A; updated build succeeds and provider turn resumes.
steps.evidence: Old/new build IDs and template version UUID B, sanitized dispatcher result.

cleanup: Restore reviewed QA active version and clean recorded disposable workspaces only with authorization.

variants.title: Pinned rebuild stays on A

steps.action: Apply A UUID template_version to both QA pools and restart QA relay; with B active, start new unique sessions for both providers.
steps.expected: Builds use A if QA template permits non-active builds and relay account has required permission; otherwise mark blocked and use Q04-c, not false pass.
steps.evidence: Redacted config hash, active B and pinned A UUIDs, build IDs.

steps.action: Stop only these QA workspaces, redeliver SAME sessions and poll builds.
steps.expected: Rebuilds still use A; no silent switch to active B.

cleanup: Remove pin and restart dedicated QA relay; clean QA workspace IDs with authorization.

variants.title: Non-active pin degrades without template update

steps.action: On QA template only enable require_active_version; leave B active and pin pools to A; use a QA service account without template:update, then restart QA relay.
steps.expected: Affected QA pools fail verification and health gauges become 0; no new dispatch from degraded pools.
steps.evidence: Template setting, role check, redacted verification error, per-pool gauges and readiness (503 if all pools fail).

cleanup: Restore approved QA template setting/role, remove pin, restart relay and confirm both gauges 1.

variants.title: Rebuild refusal versus transient error

steps.action: On existing QA session/workspace only, inject scoped rebuild HTTP 400 then 403 in separate runs; redeliver same session and poll dispatch history.
steps.expected: Each 400/403 is classified terminal, not retried indefinitely; provider receives applicable safe failure outcome.
steps.evidence: Request/build IDs, sanitized HTTP code, retry decision and provider-visible outcome.

steps.action: Replace fixture with one transient rebuild failure and restore it after one attempt; redeliver a different QA session.
steps.expected: Transient rebuild can retry and succeed; not classified as terminal 400/403.
steps.evidence: UTC attempts and final build version.

cleanup: Disable all scoped faults, remove pin, restore QA active version/settings and clean only authorized QA workspaces.

notes: A/B markers must not contain credentials. Template versions are real recorded UUIDs, never invented values.
Do not accidentally grant template:update to make Q04-c pass.
